metadata.description: Lightweight IMAP email access for Claude Code, as an MCP server or a skill-backed CLI

plugins.name: imap-slim-mcp
plugins.description: Lightweight IMAP email MCP server. Read, search, flag and draft mail; markdown or plain bodies, chosen explicitly. Multi-account. See imap-slim-cli for the same actions as a skill, which costs no context until used.

plugins.name: imap-slim-cli
plugins.description: Same IMAP mail access as imap-slim-mcp, as a skill-backed CLI. Costs no context until a command runs, where an enabled MCP server loads its tool schema into every session.
